integrity: All general limit claims follow from the self-contained phase-plane proof. Independent verification not performed; standard-library finite checks are supplementary and not exhaustive proofs.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to one homogeneous deterministic SIS compartment with quadratic prevalence-dependent recovery gain and an initially subthreshold recovery multiplier. It does not classify networked models, stochastic extinction, other gain exponents or discrete interventions. Complete publication priority is unverified.
title: A sharp critical-gain phase diagram for quadratic adaptive SIS recovery
